reviews.evidence: Runs capture→section plan→React assembly/build→fingerprint, weight and visual scoring→worst-section repair; CLI and terminal states are documented.
reviews.concern: Narrow cloning use case; no shown clone artifact, score output, tests, or troubleshooting.

reviews.evidence: Captures shell/agent history with outputs, stable refs, search/show/zoom/filter, reusable WorkSets, MCP/TUI access, encrypted sharing, synced groups, and five GIF workflows.
reviews.concern: Little recovery guidance for sync conflicts, daemon failures, or provider parse errors.

reviews.evidence: Documents 22 tools for simulator/USB iPhone streaming, build/run, semantic and OCR actions, logs, previews and debugging, with parameters, quick-start prompts and smoke coverage.
reviews.concern: Requires macOS/full Xcode; real-device signing is involved and deep phone row reads can take 15–25 seconds.

reviews.evidence: Runs Stata through agents with command guards, RAM limits, log capture, data handlers and layered config; doctor output and five explicit research scenarios are shown.
reviews.concern: Core tool-call examples, analysis outputs and an end-to-end Stata demo are absent; most steps are installation.

reviews.evidence: Electron shell adds native lifecycle/recovery, provider/model UI, theme, Files sidebar, reminder summary and ZIP export, backed by a verified cross-platform release process.
reviews.concern: No product screenshot or end-to-end session example; most actionable steps cover installation and development.

reviews.evidence: Ships self-hosted/Cloudflare agent lifecycle, sandboxes, APIs, harness SDK, tools, MCP, skills, memory, vaults, model cards and three integrations with runnable flows.
reviews.concern: The broad operator surface and external integrations create substantial deployment and security complexity; no UI demo.

reviews.evidence: Exposes 38 desktop/browser MCP tools, local OCR/optional YOLO, BYOK vision, managed or external Chrome and CDP self-healing, with strict-confirm safety and 60 tests stated.
reviews.concern: No concrete browser/desktop tool-call examples or visible automation results; Linux desktop control is partial.

reviews.evidence: Ten step-by-step scenarios cover supervised long-term memory, sync, todos/search, internal and external agent orchestration, prompts, branching, notifications, reviews and canvas.
reviews.concern: No screenshots or result transcripts, and the broad surface has no README-visible test or compatibility matrix.

reviews.evidence: Packages an offline DSH/Termux Android runtime with bash, file-to-session, search, notifications, mobile UI, console, watchdog rollback, atomic verified updates and SAF bridge.
reviews.concern: Preview-only: ADB is incomplete, third-party plugins are likely buggy, and the README says not to use it in production.

reviews.evidence: Provides three supervised memory tiers, nine providers, search/query/distill/archive flows, scoped UI/headless surfaces, a first workflow, GIF/video and UI screenshots.
reviews.concern: External providers vary in semantics and require separate services; there is no deterministic secret scanner.
